articleTitle: Detectify : Image Tampering Detection using Error Level Analysis (ELA) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In the evolving digital landscape, the proliferation of manipulated images poses a significant challenge to the authenticity and integrity of visual content. This project investigates cutting-edge image manipulation detection techniques, employing a combination of Error Level Analysis (ELA) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for robust prediction. Focusing on the widely-used CASIA V2.0 dataset, the study provides a comprehensive evaluation of image manipulation methods. Error Level Analysis is utilized as a forensic tool to identify alterations in the compression levels of manipulated images. By scrutinizing variations in error levels, the project aims to enhance the detection accuracy of manipulated regions within visual content. The CNN model is meticulously crafted and trained using preprocessed ELA images to acquire nuanced features essential for discerning tampering- induced alterations. The proposed hybrid approach, integrating ELA and CNN, establishes a robust framework for detecting image manipulation that is adaptable and efficient. Through the meticulous examination of the CASIA V2.0 dataset, this project contributes to ongoing efforts in combating digital image manipulation. This study serves as a valuable resource for forensic analysts, researchers, and practitioners working towards ensuring the veracity of digital images, offering a nuanced understanding of image manipulation techniques in the contemporary digital era.

articleTitle: Optimization of Smart Home Appliances with Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Development of smart grid has given the opportu-nity for the residential consumers to lower their electricity cost by planning their power usage. Accordingly the system operators have the opportunity to include the renewable Energy sources penetration thereby allowing grids dependability by demand side adaptability and load control. Thus, in this work the main goal is to give customers direct access to smart controller to reduce the energy usage depending on their preferences and degree of comfort. In order to optimally schedule different household appliances in a smart home, a unique architecture of home energy management system (HEMS) and an automated Demand response (DR) framework is proposed in this research. Additionally the paper proposes particle swarm optimization to tackle this optimization problem with integration of rooftop solar and wind energies. The proposed method is validated for different case studies of scheduling both in weekdays and weekdays and was found to be very effective in reducing the energy cost of the residential consumers.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Neural Architectures for Poem Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Recent advancements in artificial intelligence have significantly impacted various sectors, including the creative domain of poetry generation. This paper examines the effectiveness of neural architectures, specifically Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM), Vicuna-1B, and GPT-2, in gener-ating poetry. By initiating these models with detailed prompts encompassing genre and theme, we aim to explore their capacity for producing poetry that resonates with human emotion and stylistic precision. Our methodology involves comparing the poems generated by these models against a curated dataset of existing poems, employing BLEU and ROUGE scores for a comprehensive evaluation. This study seeks to shed light on the potential of each model in the field of computational creativity, offering insights into their applicability in poetry generation.

articleTitle: Generating Book Suggestions Using a Hybrid Model with Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Recommendation Systems are ubiquitous, whether it is in social media posts, advertisements, or digital book and movie libraries. Many recommender systems suggest items based on the product or its use and do not consider the user's sentiments towards the item or user preferences. This paper employs a hybrid model comprising a mix of popularity and content-based approaches to generate book suggestions along with sentiment analysis. Sentiment analysis of the book descriptions and user feedback enhances the recommendations. This recommendation system also incorporates classification and filtering of explicit books based on the user's age to generate the top 10 recommendations of books. The measurement metrics implemented in testing this proposed model are Precision, Recall, Mean Absolute Error, and Mean Squared Error to test the recommendation system's performance. The proposed system with high precision and low error results in notable additions to existing recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Detection of Parkinson's Disease using Machine Learning Algorithms from Speech Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a long-term neurological con-dition that impacts 60 % of people above 50 years of age, it results in a decrease in voice in 90% of individuals and ranks as the second most prevalent illness among the elderly. It affects the gait, speech, and memory. The diagnosis and treatment requires physical visits which are extremely difficult and cumbersome for the older people. Making use of speech signals for the Parkinson's disease diagnosis provides a non-invasive, less time-consuming and painless experience to the patients. This paper's main objective is to build a feature vector that comprises of a time domain feature, Zero Crossing Rate, a frequency domain feature, the Spectral Centroid and the cepstral features from the 14 coefficients of Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC), MFCC Delta and MFCC Delta-Delta. Support Vector Machine (Linear and Polynomial kernels), Random Forest, and Logistic Regression are utilised to classify Parkinson's disease. Support Vector Machine (both Linear and Polynomial kernels) achieved the maximum accuracy of 92.31 % as in contrast to the other machine learning algorithms considered in this paper. It is found from the comparison with the existing models that the proposed model with SVM classifier performed better than the other models.

articleTitle: Mental State Report From Social Media Activity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper is about making user experience with social media better, by developing the complete analysis tool that would parse textual data from different platforms like Instagram, Facebook or Reddit. By developing a custom browser extension, the user-generated content is captured in real-time and can also be processed subsequently. The project comprises two key components: Emotion Detection and Hate Speech Detection. The Emotion Detection system uses sophisticated Natural Language Processing NLP techniques, such as BERT models to identify users' emotional state through their social media posts. This information is then used to develop a daily mental state report by which users are able to gain insights into their emotional health over time. Further, the Hate Speech Detection system leverages machine learning algorithms to detect and mark words that may be harmful or offensive in user- generated content. This feature enhances positive and inclusive Internet environment. The project goes beyond the analysis; it includes a pragmatic component suggesting specific tasks for users depending on their mental state reports. These recommendations are aimed at promoting positive interaction and enhancing the user's overall well-being. This project offers a comprehensive insight into users' emotional experiences on social media using state-of-the-art NLP and machine learning approaches. The combination of task recommendations and text summarization increases interaction among users, creating a pleasant atmosphere where people can enjoy using social media. The browser extension is a multipurpose tool that does not merely analyze but provides some improvements to the user's mental health and online activity.

articleTitle: Improved Hardware Accelerator for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Driven by the need for increased precision, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have surpassed traditional platforms, leading to the exploration of alternatives such as GPUs, ASICs, and notably, Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs). FPGAs are perfect for complicated CNN acceleration because they combine low latency, energy efficiency, and flexibility in a unique way. FPGA development has been made easier by High-Level Synthesis (HLS) tools, which have improved the effectiveness and quality of designs. The optimization potential of Xilinx Deep Learning Processing Units (DPUs) within FPGA-based CNN acceleration is examined in this study, with attention paid to changing the internal parameters to suit the needs. An overview of related work is presented, focusing on the previous attempts at building and improving such Hardware accelerators. The proposed workflow makes use of the flexibility provided by DPUs. In addition to the results showing effectiveness of DPUs, insights into their architecture and performance characteristics are presented.

articleTitle: Advance Monitoring System for Mountain Climber's Health
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative solution for continuously monitoring the health of mountain climbers in real-time. The proposed system collects vital health parameters such as pulse rate, body temperature, live location, and the orientation of the climber's body. In cases where the climber's body temperature drops below a certain threshold, a Peltier device is employed to initiate heating and restore the body temperature to a safe level. The gathered data is transmitted wirelessly using long range (LoRa) technology for efficient long-distance communication. A receiver module captures the transmitted data and displays it on a liquid crystal display (LCD) for immediate observation. Additionally, the receiver module is connected to the Blynk cloud platform via the internet, enabling remote access to the collected data from anywhere in the world. This advanced monitoring system ensures the safety and well-being of mountain climbers by providing real-time health status updates and intervention capabilities, thereby enhancing the overall safety measures in mountainous regions.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on QoS Enhancement in SDN based VANET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In the current road scenario the number of vehicles expanded steadily, which resulted in serious traffic issues including congestion, a feasible path, and related problems like accidents. To overcome this, the Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) offers top-notch services including emergency alerts and safety applications. However, due to the vast number of vehicles, ITS limits scalability, adaptability, and traffic control activities. Thus, it is necessary to expand the conventional Vehicular Ad hoc Network (VANET) architecture. As a result, the design of Software Defined Networking (SDN) based VANET has drawn a lot of attention recently and enhanced the intelligence of VANETs. The aforementioned difficulties faced by VANET can be handled via the SDN-based VANET design. In addition to being programmable, the centralized (logically) SDN architecture contains global knowledge of the VANET architecture. Consequently, it can manage scalability with ease. The objective of this paper is to examine various SDN-based VANET algorithms to improve Quality of Service (QoS)

articleTitle: Modified Andrew's Sine Criteria Based Robust Nonlinear System Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: A new robust estimator Andrew's sine function has been widely used in robust statistics and outlier rejection. Recently adaptive exponential functional link network (AEFLN) with various cost functions has been proposed for numerous applications. This manuscript proposed a robust AEFLN using a modified exponential Andrew's sine cost function, called the modified exponential Andrew's sine criteria-based robust adaptive exponential functional link network (MEAS-RAEFLN) algorithm for robust nonlinear system identification. The update rule for the weights and the decay parameters are introduced. The performance of the algorithm is verified under an impulsive noise environment with various simulation results. Further, for a stable state the bound of the learning rate is derived and the comparison of computational complexity is also presented.

articleTitle: Economic Load Dispatch with Integration of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: A transition to electric vehicles (EVs) is favored owing to its multifaceted benefits, such as reduced noise and environmental pollution. However, integrating EVs into the grid system may affect its operation. Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) refers to the provision of power to the consumers at the least cost possible while taking into account the active and reactive power constraints specified for the system. This paper implements the ELD of a system, taking into consideration the operational constraints of the Electric Vehicle Charging Statuin (EVCS) and the power system. The primary aim of the algorithm developed is to minimize the cost associated with the system at various stages. The Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) techniques have been used to arrive at feasible solutions for a 5-bus system.

articleTitle: Drought and Salinity Stress Classification in Soyabean Crops: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Soyabean cultivation encounters significant obstacles attributed to abiotic stresses like drought and salinity, especially in areas characterized by tropical climates. In this paper, we seek to fill gaps identified in previous research efforts, particularly the lack of comprehensive analysis regarding genotypic factors and the underutilization of morphological characteristics in machine learning algorithms for Soyabean genotype selection. We propose a novel approach to bridge these gaps by employing six morphological variables in machine learning models. Through the process of training the models using specific parameters, plants are categorized into either the Control group or the Stress Group, which comprises of genotypes facing drought or salinity stress. Various models such as Random Forest Classifier (RFC), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gradient Boosting (GB), k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) and Naive Bayes algorithms are included, offering an in-depth comparative analysis of the performance and feature importance under each model used. However, the Support Vector Machine was identified as the most accurate algorithm with an accuracy of 96.79% in stress classification of Soyabean genotypes. Incorporating morphological parameters in machine learning models enhances the accuracy and efficiency of Stress Classification process, increasing the sustainability of Soyabean production and its ability to withstand environmental adversities.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Based Field Oriented Control of PMSM for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper provides an in-depth analysis of the application of fuzzy logic-based field-oriented control (FOC) implemented for permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) used in electric vehicles (EVs), FOC is a widely used control technique for PMSM drives as it provides precise control over torque and flux. However, traditional FOC methods may face practical challenges in tuning the PI controller and suffer from large overshoot and settling times. This study explores how fuzzy logic-based FOC addresses these challenges and offers advantages in dynamic response, efficiency, and robustness. A comparative analysis is carried out and the paper shows that fuzzy logic-based FOC is better at adapting to different operating conditions and controlling them precisely compared to traditional FOC and FOC with hysteresis control methods.

articleTitle: QHealth: A Blockchain Based Smart Healthcare Consensus Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The development of blockchain technology has had far-reaching effects, notably on environmental monitoring, by radically altering the nature of decentralized processing and data integrity. Traditional blockchains, on the other hand, have problems with security, energy efficiency, and scalability. This study introduces QHealth- a smart healthcare consensus method for Quantum Entangled Medical Record (EQMR) Protocol which is part of our research work QUMA: Quantum Unified Medical Architecture using Blockchain. QHealth makes use of entanglement principles and verified quantum random numbers. Based on real-time sensor data from M-IoT sensors, QHealth simulated a blockchain network with 5 to 50 nodes, improving transaction throughput, consensus time, and energy efficiency. The study took into account things like data size, ambient noise, and network latency. Due to factors such as network size and data complexity, performance showed a nonlinear relationship with node count. Energy usage showed a non-linear growth with the number of nodes, although consensus time climbed logarithmically. When it comes to smart health and other conscious uses of blockchain technology, QHealth represents a positive step forward. It improves energy efficiency, transaction processing, decentralization, and security by using quantum entanglement. The study lays the groundwork for effective and sustainable environmental monitoring using blockchain, which has far-reaching consequences.

articleTitle: Growing Greener: Exploring the Creative Potential of Deep Learning in Agricultural Disease Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: According to estimates, by mid-2030, there will be 8.6 billion people on the planet. The human population has been growing exponentially. There will be a rise in food production and consumption due to the massive population growth. Crop disease is the primary danger to food security, which damages agricultural goods while growing. Due to the limited availability of infrastructure, it remains challenging to recognize crop-damaging diseases in various parts of the world. Deep learning methods and computer vision technologies are used in this work to help identify agricultural illnesses. The train set is used to train the model, and the data split is used for validation. The farmer can use the app (Identifying and Resolving Crop Diseases using Deep Learning) to take pictures of the crops and examine whether or not there are any infections, proving the solution's viability.

articleTitle: Single CFOA based Grounded Meminductor Emulator and its Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This study introduces a new grounded meminductor emulator that combines a single Current Feedback Operational Amplifier (CFOA), a memristor and necessary passive components. The proposed circuit eliminates the need for multiple building blocks, offering features like individual resistive tunability, which is lacking in traditional single op-amp-based simulators designed for similar impedances. Simulations were conducted using LTspice software and a 0.18μm CMOS technology platform. Additionally, the proposed meminductor emulator has practical significance in the development of a chaotic oscillator.

articleTitle: AI - Enhanced Wheelchair Solutions for Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper is a design of a voice-controlled wheelchair which is well preferred for persons diagnosed with paraplegic and quadriplegic patients who can use voice commands to control and operate the wheelchair. Furthermore, an approach to sleep detection is developed through the utilization of OpenCV, enhancing the system's capability to identify periods of prolonged drowsiness indicative of potential sleep onset is also integrated. By harnessing the power of these technologies, we aim to enhance the independence, accessibility, and quality of life for individuals facing mobility challenges, ultimately paving the way for a more secure future. The Blynk app is used to develop a customized interface for controlling the wheelchair using voice commands. Users can create buttons within the Blynk app that correspond to specific commands, such as “move forward,” “turn left,” “turn right,” or “stop.” These commands can then be triggered by voice inputs detected by the app, allowing individuals to navigate the wheelchair hands-free. This Voice-Controlled AI Wheelchair project helps to enhance mobility for individuals with physical disabilities by developing a wheelchair that can be controlled using voice commands for navigation. This innovative assistive technology leverages voice recognition and artificial intelligence (AI) to provide users with intuitive and hands-free control over their mobility devices.

articleTitle: Optimal Deep Learning Models for Post-Flood House Detection in Drone Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Floods remain a persistent threat to human lives and infrastructure. Identifying flood-impacted houses in drone imageries will support the rescue teams to prioritize rescue operations in highly affected areas. This study investigates the performance of various deep-learning detection models for post-flood house detection using drone imagery. Our research aims to identify the most suitable model and optimized parameters for accurately and efficiently identifying flood-affected houses, thereby facilitating timely disaster response and recovery efforts. The paper explores various state-of-the-art architectures and provides a thorough performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Radial Distribution Networks with Stud Krill Herd Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In radial distribution system, reconfiguration is a mixed-integer nonlinear optimisation problem, which minimises power loss without incurring new costs. The reconfiguration problem in the radial distribution system may be solved by applying the Stud krill herd method, which is suggested in this research for system active power loss minimization and voltage profile improvement. By taking into account various load circumstances, the suggested algorithm's performance is confirmed on IEEE standard test systems with 33 and 69 buses. It is shown how the suggested SKHA compares to current techniques for reconfiguring radial distribution networks. The results were compared with current techniques for reconfiguring radial distribution networks. Our findings show that the SKHA method significantly enhanced voltage profile, reduced power loss, and improved the overall solution quality. Specifically, SKHA was able to reduce real power loss by 33.85% and reactive power loss by 28.45% for the 33-bus system and 56.17% of real power loss and 43.85% of reactive power loss for the 69-bus system.

articleTitle: Enhanced Stacked Ensemble Learning for Cloud-Based Darknet Traffic Analysis and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: To improve cybersecurity threat identification and incident response capabilities, the suggested cloud-based darknet traffic analysis and categorization system incorporates cutting-edge machine learning algorithms and data pretreatment techniques. The system uses altered stacking ensemble learning techniques to combine several threat intelligence sources to improve its comprehension of new cyber threats that are present in the darknet environment. Cloud infrastructure-enabled real-time incident response techniques allow for quick threat containment and mitigation. Predictive models for cybersecurity threat detection are more accurate and dependable by employing adaptive data preparation techniques. By facilitating stakeholder exchange of real-time threat intelligence, the system, which emphasizes collaborative frameworks, encourages proactive cybersecurity actions. Adherence to data privacy laws and industry best practices is ensured by seamless integration with regulatory compliance requirements. By using the suggested method, threat detection efficiency and accuracy have significantly improved, enabling enterprises to successfully foresee and counteract cyberthreats originating from the darknet.

articleTitle: An Anti-Misalignment and Interoperable EV Wireless Charging System incorporating an LCC-S-based Tetrad Structured pad
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The growing interest in the adoption of Electric vehicles (EV) is highly entertained by global governments on considering the environmental aspects of achieving sustainable and energy-efficient transportation systems. Mass utilization of EVs faces challenges in the safer and more reliable method of charging vehicle batteries. Inductive Power Transfer (IPT) technology has emerged as a promising solution that provides a hassle-free charging experience for EV customers. The charging pad design is a critical parameter that determines the overall efficiency of an inductive EV charging system. The paper proposes a Tetrad structured pad (TTP) to achieve high-power transmission between transmitter and receiver charging pads. The paper studied the performance of the proposed charging pad against different misalignment conditions and analyzed the interoperability characteristic of TTP with different receiver pads since every vehicle pad has been designed with its unique size and shape in the future. The performance of the proposed pad has been compared with a double-D pad (DDP) of similar geometrical conditions. The simulated results of parameters including mutual inductance (M), output power <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(P_{out})$</tex>, and DC-DC efficiency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\eta)$</tex> show that the proposed pad outperforms the existing DDP. Finally, experimental verification has been achieved to verify the feasibility of the proposed pad in the IPT charging system for EVs.

articleTitle: Rice Leaf Disease Detection Using ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Although rice is a staple food worldwide, it is susceptible to various diseases that can significantly decrease the crop's quality and yield. A swift and precise diagnosis is essential for effective treatment. The earlier traditional approaches were time-consuming and needed to classify all diseases better. Novel technologies like computer vision and deep learning are being investigated to detect and identify crop diseases. In this paper, ResN et50 is employed, a type of Convolutional Neural Network used to classify Bacterial blight, Blast, Brown spot, and Tungro diseases. The Rice Leaf Disease Detection (RLDD) system is tested using a dataset of high-resolution images of healthy and diseased rice leaves of varying severity. RLDD is a cutting-edge solution that accurately identifies and categorizes rice leaf diseases. Hence, this method performs well when pre-processing methodologies are used to increase image quality and data augmentation to diversify datasets. The comprehensive evaluation of the proposed model considers several metrics, such as Fl-score, accuracy, precision, and recall, with outstanding results of nearly 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy across four classes of rice diseases.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional (3-D) objects classification by means of phase-only digital holographic information using Alex Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper presents the application of the Alex network for binary classification of three-dimensional (3-D) objects in phase-only digital holographic information. The 3-D objects considered for the binary classification task include ‘triangle-square’, ‘circle-square’, ‘square-circle’, and ‘triangle-circle’. The ‘triangle-square’ object is assigned to the TRUE class, while the ‘circle-square’, ‘square-circle’, and ‘triangle-circle’ objects are assigned to the FALSE class. The digital holograms of 3-D objects were generated using the two-step phase-shifting digital holography (PSDH) technique and processed computationally to extract phase-only digital holographic data. Following this, the Alex Network was trained on a dataset comprising 2880 phase-only images to yield the outcomes. The study validates its findings by presenting results such as the confusion matrix, ROC curve, and precision-recall characteristics.

articleTitle: Advanced Pothole Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Road transport is the most common mode of transport worldwide, so regulatory authorities should pay more attention to the safety of passengers. Despite the various causes of road safety problems, poorly maintained roads are important, as potholes appear to be a major cause of accidents worldwide. This paper proposes a comprehensive approach to identifying potholes, autonomous filling of them, and maintaining a database with constant updates on the potholes and their clearance to prevent accidents and improve road safety. A web-based portal reports the potholes to concerned authorities by sending the location, size, depth, and predictive analytics to anticipate pothole-related issues. Implemented as a monocular vision autonomous car prototype using an Arduino UNO as a processing chip. This paper highlights the importance of proactive measures to enhance road safety in addition to pothole prevention. Regulators are urged to invest in remediation and technical improvements to reduce the risks associated with poor roads. Together, we may assist in reducing accidents and improving overall road safety by encouraging good driving practices and citizen participation in reporting accidents on the roads. However, combined with the latest innovations like predictive analytics and automated vehicle technology, this collaborative approach has a chance to build safer routes for communities across the world.

articleTitle: Unveiling Ion Channel Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper explains how faults or anomalies might be indicated by changes in the initial condition of tissues, particularly the flow of potassium and sodium ions with leaks. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are becoming more and more capable of being used, even if these mistakes have been found in tissue systems. CNNs are trained to identify patterns in data, much like digital analysts. By providing information regarding both typical and exceptional motor function, we hope to help peo-ple comprehend that things aren't always correct. Our research examines how CNN s can be used to forecast changes in ion channel function, which could indicate important problems with neural properties. With this approach, we want to increase our capacity to detect and treat arthritis early on. By in-tegrating CNN s into fault detection algorithms, we want to pave the way for more ecologically friendly neural diagnostic and therapeutic approaches.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of Battery Swapping Stations in Power System Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: There has been an increase in electric vehicle (EV) sales in recent years. The prime disadvantage of using EV s is the availability of battery charging stations(BCS) and the long waiting time for battery charging. Battery swapping stations (BSS) are alternatives to BCS and do not have the waiting time associated with charging a battery. The increased use of EV s will increase the burden on the power system network. Placement of BSS at optimal locations will lead to reduced transmission losses and improved voltage profile. However, they may also require the provision of additional transmission corridors. In this context, this paper explores the strategic placement of BSS within a power system. In addition, prior to the strategic placement, the effect of placement of BSS on the reinforcement cost(RFC), transmission 10ss(PL), and voltage deviation index(VDI) are investigated. The optimal strategic placement is carried out considering the minimum RFC, minimum PL, and maximum VDI using the Genetic Algorithm.

articleTitle: IoT Based Weather Forecasting for Rainfall Prediction Using Intensified Long Short-Term Memory Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the possible uses of artificial neural networks (ANNs) and intensified long short-term memory (LSTM) for rainfall forecasting. The effectiveness of these weather forecasting techniques was evaluated and assigned a score. Materials and Techniques: For the sample test analysis, intensified LSTM and ANN with pre-test power (G-power) of 80% and alpha error rate (Err) of 0.05 were used. The results of the MATLAB simulations show that the ANN has an accuracy of 95.68% and the Intensified LSTM has an accuracy of 87.99%. We discover that the achieved accuracy ratio is 0.034 (p 0.05) using the statistical application SPSS. According to this study, when it comes to advanced weather forecasting, the ANN algorithm outperforms the Intensified LSTM technique in terms of rainfall prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of IPFC-Based Damping Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This work presents a novel design methodology for creating a supplementary damping controller based on an Interline Power flow controller (IPFC). This strategy appears to be quite effective and yields positive results. Low-frequency oscillation (LFO) is a significant problem in every power system. This is mainly due to a minor disturbance in a power system. This proposed study considers an IPFC installed inside an SMIB power system. A damping controller is used to lower the low frequency of oscillation. An optimization difficulty is determining the controller parameter. This study discovers the damping controller's parameters by applying the Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA). The simulation-based results are displayed and contrasted with previously published results derived from the Phase Compensation Technique (PCT).

articleTitle: A New Intrusion Detection Model for Using CNN-LSTM with CatBoost for Detecting Known and Innovative Cyberattacks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Due to the rapid expansion of websites and the massive exchange of data about private information over the last few years, the internet has become an indispensable part of peoples' everyday lives. Because of its widespread use, the internet is more vulnerable to information theft and intrusions, which also expands the field of attack for assaults. The CICIDS Datasets was used by the suggested system to train and validate the proposed model. In order to lower these risks and improve internet security, this study proposes an (IDS) that uses the and the Parallel CNN-LSTM model for feature extraction. This technique extracts network packet features using Parallel CNN-LSTM and uses CatBoost for classification. This improves intrusion detection by effectively differentiating between malicious and legitimate communications. The suggested IDS model (Parallel CNN-LSTM with CatBoost) successfully categorizes network traffic as one of two types using convolutional neural networks.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of BLDC Motor-Based Electric Vehicle Using Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This study focuses on enhancing the efficiency and reliability of electric vehicles (EVs) by designing and analyzing a system based on a Brushless DC (BLDC) motor integrated with a bi-directional DC-DC driver and controlled by Fuzzy Logic. The incorporation of Fuzzy Logic aims to optimize the energy transfer between the battery and motor, improving the vehicle's state of charge (SOC), which is essential for increasing driving range and battery lifespan. Simulation results confirm significant improvements in SOC management, reduced energy losses, and overall vehicle performance. This research provides both theoretical insights and practical implications for the advancement of EV technologies, particularly in optimizing power systems for better energy efficiency and reliability in commercial EV applications.

articleTitle: Eye Controlled AI Assistive Device : Empowering Paralyzed Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This innovative system presents an eye-controlled wheelchair for people with mobility impairments and uses real-time eye tracking to interpret the user's gaze and translate it into a wheelchair. In this paper, hardware and software architecture of thas been described. The system offers seamless integration and scalability, and aims to improve the independence and quality of life of people with paralysis by providing intuitive and responsive mobility assistance in complex situations. This paper presents a compact but robust solution for wheelchair control using eye tracking for the paralysed. The system uses advanced computer vision techniques to accurately interpret eye movements in real time, providing smooth and efficient navigation for people with mobility impairments. This technology-based approach aims to improve accessibility and provide a reliable solution to improve mobility and independence.

articleTitle: Change Vector Change Indices Method for Unsupervised Remote Sensing Change Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Unsupervised Remote sensing change detection is very important because it addresses the problem of scarcity in the data availability in training. Some of the researchers are successful in finding the change regions but are not able to classify what changes happened in those regions. Nearly every study faces challenges in generalizing the fluctuations occurring during both the growing and non-growing seasons. The current study utilizes a novel architecture consisting of two parts. The first part involves proposing change regions through the change vector calculation method and applying Otsu's Thresholding on the calculated change vectors, while the second part entails classifying these proposed change regions into vegetation change, building change, and non-change regions. non-change region classification process aims to eliminate false changes identified by the change vector analysis and Otsu's Thresholding. In the second stage, NDVI, NDWI, and NDMI indices are compared and the resulting change mask obtained is subjected for element-wise multiplication operation with the change mask obtained in the first stage. The study addressed the challenge of generalizing short-term changes, such as those occurring during the growing and non-growing seasons, by computing the median of pixels over a time range encompassing both types of changes. Additionally, the method was fine-tuned using NIT Puducherry data from two time periods. Subsequently, the entire Karaikal district was considered to examine the changes comprehensively. The present study outperformed different state of the art methods like CVI_OTSU, PCI_Kmeans, Continuous Change Detection and Classification (CCDC). The present study got better results with an accuracy of 86.07 and kappa coefficient of 0.7898.

articleTitle: Fake Social Media Profile Identification and Report Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In the digital age, Online Social Networking platforms are integral to daily life, but they also attract malicious bots that mimic human behaviour and pose cybersecurity threats. This literature review focuses on recent Machine Learning-based techniques for detecting and classifying bots on major social media platforms. It covers supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised methods, dataset details, and feature categories. While the technology is advancing, an ongoing challenge lies in the creation of ever- evolving bots to evade detection. The study offers insights into the evolving landscape of cybersecurity and the need for continual research in this field, but potential drawbacks may include data privacy concerns, The pervasive influence of the internet and social media as platforms for real-time information dissemination and their potential to shape perceptions and lives. It highlights the concern that unverified and malicious content can significantly impact users' perceptions. The paper offers a taxonomy for classifying malicious information at various stages and presents technologies to combat the issue from content generation to containment. The results illustrate the efficacy of machine learning in improving the dependability and safety of social media platforms, offering a scalable approach to address the increasing problem of online deception.

articleTitle: Enhancing Biosensor Sensitivity Using Dielectrically Modulated Triple-Gate Heterojunction Tunnel FET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In the ever-evolving landscape of healthcare, early detection of health issues is crucial. Biosensors offer a promising solution, integrating biological recognition elements with electronic signal transduction. Among them, Field-Effect Transistor (FET)-based biosensors stand out for their label-free detection method and potential for non-invasive biopsies. Dielectric modulation in FETs facilitates biomolecule detection by altering electrical properties. We present a study comparing Double Gate Dielectrically Modulated Tunnel Field Effect Transistor (DG-DM-TFET) with Triple Gate Heterojunction Dielectrically Modulated TFET (TG-HJ-DM-TFET). The latter exhibits significantly improved sensitivity, essential for biosensing applications. Our work explores structural modifications and material choices to enhance sensitivity, demonstrating a five-fold increase in sensitivity compared to conventional TFETs.

articleTitle: Energy Audit for Achieving Net Zero: A Case Study of the Plywood Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Energy is a major driver of economic development in any country. The energy sector holds critical importance due to ever-increasing energy needs, necessitating substantial investments to meet them. Energy audits are crucial in identifying energy wastage and losses, and in providing techniques to minimize them. The techniques recommended by the energy audit minimize losses, reduce monthly electricity bills and reduces the carbon emissions. The objective of Energy Management is to achieve and maintain optimal energy procurement and utilization throughout the organization, minimizing energy costs and wastage without compromising production and quality. Energy Audit serves as the cornerstone of a systematic approach to decision-making in energy management. It aims to balance total energy inputs with their use, identifying all energy streams within a facility. In this study the detailed energy audit of a plywood industry is carried. The major areas where energy wastage is happening are identified. The recommendations are made after thorough techno-economic analysis for energy efficient operation.

articleTitle: The Future of Online Shopping: Blockchain- Powered E-Commerce Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: A cutting-edge online marketplace that uses blockchain technology to transform how we purchase and sell goods and services is known as a blockchain- powered e-commerce platform. This platform uses a decentralized network of computers, also known as nodes, to maintain a transparent and impenetrable record of all transactions instead of depending on a central authority like a bank or a company. A blockchain-based e-commerce platform is a secure, transparent, and trusted online marketplace. It does away with the need for intermediaries, improves security, and provides a world market where users can confidently conduct peer-to-peer transactions. This novel strategy could change how online commerce and shopping are performed.

articleTitle: An Electronically Tunable DDCC- Based Floating Meminductor Emulator and Its Application in Chua's Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel circuit for emulating a floating flux-controlled meminductor, employing a minus-type differential difference current conveyor (DDCC-). Utilizing a single DDCC-, along with a resistor, memristor, and capacitor, the circuit is simulated using TSMC CMOS process parame-ters in LTspice. Simulation results encompass input current- flux relationships, time responses, memory characteristics, and Monte Carlo analysis. Notably, the circuit enables adjustable flux values through transconductance gain and input current signal frequency, eliminating the need for passive component matching. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the proposed meminductor emulator is validated by integrating it as a non-linear element in Chua's chaotic oscillator, underscoring its potential applications.

articleTitle: Design of Compact Circular Slotted Patch Monopole Antenna for Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In this paper, a Compact Monopole antenna is designed, simulated, and evaluated in a 2.45 GHz ISM band. Polyamide Kapton with a thickness of 1mm is used as substrate. The suggested antenna is intended to test in both on-body and free space scenarios. The proposed antenna is intended for biomedical imaging and sensing purposes. The compactness of the design ensures portability and compatibility for wearable medical devices. Computer simulation technology (CST) software has been used for the design and simulation of antenna. The optimization techniques and fine tuning of the parameters provides an optimal performance of the antenna in terms of bandwidth, gain and directivity. A Microwave Imaging algorithm (MWI) is used to detect the precise location of the tumor. With this, the designed approach is helpful in analyzing the precise location of the tumor.

articleTitle: Harmonic Impact on the Power Distribution Network due to 30 KW EV Chargers – A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The worldwide e-mobility boom is an important development in the direction of sustainable resource use and environmental protection. The need for infrastructure for charging electric vehicles is growing as countries prepare for their widespread adoption. But when connected to the utility distribution network, EV chargers-which act as non-linear loads- create harmonics, frequency deviation, voltage imbalance and volatility, which may adversely affect power quality. Since 25 KW and 30 KW EV chargers are wall-mountable and small, which simplifies and lowers installation expenses, these are the best options for charging in a variety of locations, such as offices, homes, businesses and public spaces, it is critical to understand how they affect the utility distribution system. Therefore, the implications of installing 30 KW DC chargers at public and commercial charging stations connected to the power utility network are examined in this paper.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge High-Power Laser Guardian System for Miltary Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This paper explores the advancements in laser turret technology and its diverse applications across various fields. Laser turrets have evolved significantly in terms of precision, power efficiency, and functionality, enabling their use in military defense systems, industrial manufacturing processes, medical procedures, and more. This paper embarks on a comprehensive exploration of the remarkable strides made in laser turret technology and its extensive array of applications spanning across diverse fields. Over the years, laser turret systems have undergone substantial evolution, marked by notable enhancements in precision, energy efficiency, and overall functionality. Such advancements have not only broadened the scope of their utilization but also significantly elevated their efficacy in critical domains including military defense systems, where they play pivotal roles in precision-guided weaponry, counter-drone operations, and anti-missile defense mechanisms. Moreover, laser turrets have become indispensable in industrial manufacturing processes, facilitating tasks such as laser cutting, welding, additive manufacturing, and rigorous quality control measures. This paper meticulously explores into the underlying design principles and operational mechanisms that underpin the functionality of laser turret systems while also shedding light on the current trends driving their development forward. By offering deep insights into the potential implications of these technological advancements, it endeavours to illuminate the transformative impact of laser turret technology on future innovations across numerous of sectors and industries.

articleTitle: Suricata-Based Intrusion Detection and Isolation System for Local Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Malicious activity includes intentionally disrupting or damaging computer systems, networks, or data, including distributing malware, phishing attempts, denial of service, and unauthorized access. Criminals exploit vulnerabilities for financial gain or espionage. Effective prevention involves strong cybersecurity measures such as firewalls, anti-virus software, and user training. Failure to address vulnerabilities can result in data security breaches and financial losses. An Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is essential to cybersecurity measures. It scrutinizes network data or system operations for any indications of malicious actions. It plays a vital role in identifying potential threats and taking appropriate action to ensure the security of the network or system. An IDS simplifies identifying and reacting to accurate data, safeguarding critical data and systems from potential risks. Utilizing Suricata IDS, we put forth an Intrusion Detection and Isolation System (IDIS). This system is designed to identify any harmful nodes present in the Local Area Network (LAN) and isolate them. This is achieved by utilizing the configuration of an Access Control List (ACL) in the routers. This approach enhances the security measures, ensuring a safer network environment.

articleTitle: Design and development of Reversible Comparator Circuit using Qiskit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Quantum computing is at the leading edge of advanced technology that uses quantum phenomena such as entanglement and super position to solve complex problems. One of the main application is to built comparator circuit to do arithmetic operations at stipulated time. Based on this our research is to propose the design and implementation of one-bit and two-bit quantum comparators using IBM Qiskit, which is formly compared with classical comparator. Also this work represents a comprehensive overview of the techniques required to optimize and design quantum comparator circuits using real quantum simulators. The results obtained from simulation promises the comparison accuracy with classical results. From the circuit designed it is inferred that the hardware complexity is very much reduced compared to classical comparator, which are tabulated in terms of number of quantum gates. The proposed method can further be extended to generate higher order comparator circuits. These results may form the basis for further research and development that will support the advancement of quantum computing and algorithms.

articleTitle: Novel Capsule Network Algorithm Based Image Classification with Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Despite the significant impact of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) across various domains, one of their limitations is the lack of consideration for spatial orientations. Capsule networks have the potential to address these issues by incorporating the storage and routing of pose information for the features they extract throughout their architectures. This involves seeking agreement between the lower-level feature extraction and the higher-level poses at each layer. Through the storage and routing of posture information across their architectures, capsule networks aim to resolve these issues. The fundamental components of the trainable segmentation engine include an encoder network, a corresponding decoder network, and a pixel-wise classification layer. The quantitative evaluations conducted demonstrate that Capsule Networks exhibit robust performance, competitive inference times, and superior memory efficiency compared to alternative architectures. The training and testing process utilizes datasets such as MNIST and CIAFR-10 datasets. The obtained results indicate that the proposed approach successfully outperforms CNNs in addressing image classification problems.

articleTitle: A Multipurpose Microcontroller-Based Energy Management System for Microgrid Cluster Utilizing GSM Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: To harness renewable energy sources more efficiently and utilize less energy from the utility grid, a microgrid cluster power monitoring and energy management system based on renewable energy has been developed. This study introduces a microgrid energy management system that consists of two configurations of solar installations combined with microgrid clusters that are battery-powered. The real-time monitoring and control of power in the utility grid is made easier by integrating an Arduino UNO micro controller-based Global System for Mobile communication interface. With this combination, energy production efficiency is maximized, prudent energy use is encouraged, and a cost-effective Internet of Things (IoT) powered microgrid cluster for energy management is created in tandem with the utility grid. The end results are lower electricity costs, more opportunities for microgrids and the utility grid to exchange power, and a more thorough examination of electrical parameters including voltage, current, active power, and load-consumed energy amounts. Through a SIM-based mobile phone user interface, direct connection with the load management system is possible. The foundation for connection between an Arduino UNO and a mobile phone is provided by the Global System for Mobile connection Module Connectivity. This system's performance highlights its ability to effectively manage, oversee, and control energy dynamics in the utility grid as well as the microgrids, enhancing its operational competence.

articleTitle: Unveiling Sentiments: Exploring Tweet and Text Analysis for Deeper Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This work presents a comprehensive exploration of sentiment analysis on social media data, with a specific focus on Twitter. The study evaluates three state-of-the-art classifiers-Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), and Random Forest (RF)-to categorize sentiments (positive, negative, neutral) based on specific criteria. Data cleansing and classification methods are applied to extract meaningful insights from unstructured social media data. Results show that SVM achieves the highest accuracy (92.67%) among the classifiers. It also discusses the strengths and limitations of each classifier in capturing the nuances of sentiment expressions. This work contributes to the understanding of sentiment analysis techniques on social media platforms

articleTitle: Surface Water Mapping Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques from LISS-III Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Surface water mapping is crucial for preserving and strategically managing water resources. However, extracting water bodies and estimating their extent from satellite images faces challenges due to the similar spectral responses of different land types. The task of identifying optimal features from satellite images and designing deep neural networks with reduced computational complexity is also demanding. In this paper, the Machine Learning (ML) with conventional, Pixel Level Feature (PLF), and Multi Scale Feature Extraction Network (MSFEN) feature extraction methods and Lightweight Attention-based Multiscale Neural Network (LWAMNNet) are compared for surface water mapping using satellite images. Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB) are the ML classifiers considered for this study. The Linear Imaging Self-Scanning Sensor-III (LISS-III) images from the Resourcesat-2 satellite are used for experimentation. The results indicate that LWAMN-Net outperforms traditional ML techniques. Among the ML techniques, the MSFEN feature extraction method demonstrates superior performance, particularly when combined with SVM (MSFEN-SVM), outperforming other ML techniques.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Compensation in Multi-microgrid Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Development of electronics and IC technology has created a revolution. Lot of devices are integrated with electronic parts. This resulted in increase of sensitive and sophisticated devices at consumer ends. The usage of renewable energy sources are rapidly increasing because of their several advantages over non-renewable energy sources. Consumers are installing renewable energy sources at their homes. These are called as microgrids. Microgrids can also cause power quality problems. If proper power quality improvement measures are not followed chances are more for their damage. So, a need has a raised for power quality improvement. The power quality issues are like voltage sag, voltage swell, voltage distortions, flickers, harmonics and so on. The use of Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) devices has enabled the mitigation of power quality difficulties. This paper proposes of using Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) for increasing the voltage quality as it can cause malfunctioning of the de-vices at consumer end. A multi-microgrid is developed using MATLAB and test-ed with and without DVR for LLLG, LLG and LG fault conditions by connecting a non-linear load and results are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A Indian Rainfall Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: This study is intended to make rain forecasts more accurate so that there can be early warnings and measures against rain-caused disasters. We do this by using sophisticated computer programs which take into account many things like the air, the ocean, and land. In order to come up with the most precise model for predicting when it will rain heavily or not at all, we have to prioritize what data should be used first; select different methods which includes Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees, Random Forests among others while working on feature extraction through machine learning algorithms like Naive Bayes Classifier or Logistic Regression. We want our systems to always predict right - never wrong about whether there's going to be a lot of rainfall tomorrow. Our approach optimizes over daily IMD Indian Meteorological Department rainfall records from website data.gov.in.

articleTitle: Predicting Blood Sugar Levels in Diabetic Patients Using Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Globally, Diabetes, a chronic metabolic disease having Elevated Blood sugar levels, has serious health consequences. In order to deliver individualized treatment, diabetes management requires accurate blood sugar prediction from predictive models. In this work, we examine how Multilayer Perceptron neural networks can be applied to predict blood sugar levels from blood pressure readings and insulin dosages. The Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neural network design is a potent tool for making predictions about the future. MLPs are neural network architectures that consist of numerous layers of interconnected neurons, which comprise output and hidden layers. The model can recognize complex patterns and relationships because every neuron in one layer is connected to every other layer above it. A dataset comprising Blood Pressure Levels, Blood Sugar Levels, and Insulin levels, Age, BMI from individuals with diabetes has been collected. To minimize prediction errors and optimize network parameters, the backpropagation algorithm is applied.A predictive model's performance is evaluated using a Number of Measures, Sensitivity, and Mean squared Error.

articleTitle: Mobility Stick with Haptic Feedback for People with Vision Impairments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In this research, haptic motor, Node MCU, ultrasonic sensors are used to address the problem associated with the current walking stick for visually disabled people. These problems include disturbing their main sense of survival which is hearing. Hence, a system containing ultrasonic sensors, haptic motor and Internet of Things has been recommended in this study. This study illustrates that the implementation of haptic motors and ultrasonic sensors can successfully address the major issues that current alternatives face and it has a positive ad significant impact on visually disabled people. Using this method, one can monitor the person's movement and whether they fell down. This system makes use of IoT it integrate the data from sensors and update it onto the website for other person monitoring.

articleTitle: Automated Real-Time Infection Detection in Oyster Mushroom Using Smart Farming System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: In mushroom cultivation, particularly with oyster mushrooms, the presence of diseases like Trichoderma can lead to significant losses in yield and quality affecting an average of an 11% total production is affected in average cultivation. Manual monitoring and detection of such infections are labor-intensive and prone to human error. Additionally, since the infection is fungal and spreads quickly through common mediums including water, air, and humans, human surveillance leads to its continued spread. This paper aims to address these challenges by implementing an innovative solution that leverages computer vision, image processing, and IoT technologies. By minimizing human involvement, the system significantly diminishes the threat of infection spread through human contact and breathing, reducing it by 95%. It addresses the chance of human error in infection detection and optimizes the monitoring tasks. Overall, this automated solution promises an impressive 11% production boost. The proposed automated solution is evaluated with curated dataset and we are able to achieve 94% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Hybrid Technique for Generation of Image Caption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Image captioning is a fascinating and demanding work with applications in many different fields, including image retrieval, organizing and finding user-interested images, etc. It has enormous potential to replace the tedious process of creating captions for photos, and it works particularly well with massive amounts of picture data. Deep neural network-based techniques have recently shown significant success in the domains of language synthesis, machine translation, and computer vision. In this research, we present a paradigm based on encoder-decoders that may produce grammatically acceptable image captions. This model uses LSTM as the decoder and VGG16 Hybrid Places 1365 as the encoder. Model is evaluated using all standard metrics such as BLEU. Experimental results indicate that the proposed model obtained a BLEU-1 score 0.603774, BLEU-2 score 0.388514, BLUE-3 score 0.244706 on Flickr8k dataset. By comparison with the state-of-the-art techniques, the suggested strategy produced a noteworthy performance. We also present the outcomes of caption creation from real sample photographs, which supports the validity of the suggested method, in order to assess the model's effectiveness even further.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Levenberg-Marquardt and Scaled Conjugate Gradient Algorithms for Estimating Battery State of Charge
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The accurate estimation of State of Charge (SoC) is crucial for optimizing performance and to know the remaining capacity of batteries, especially in the context of Electric Vehicles (EV). Various conventional methods exist to estimate SoC; however, most of them have limitations such as slow processing speeds, computational complexity, being sensitive to initial conditions, and difficulty in handling noisy data. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes a data driven approach using deep learning techniques. In particular, this study deals with the relative effectiveness of two well-known algorithms namely Levenberg - Marquardt (LM) and Scaled Conjugate Gradient (SCG). The analysis between LM and SCG is done under varying conditions, including diverse datasets and temperatures. Through comprehensive experimentation, it was observed that the LM algorithm exhibited superior performance in converging speed and accuracy of the trained model. While LM demonstrated commendable results, the study also acknowledges that SCG may have advantages in specific scenarios.

articleTitle: A Flexible Wi-Fi 6 Antenna with low SAR for Wearable Military Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: A flexible tortoise-shaped textile antenna is designed for military applications using a polyester substrate to enhance communication reliability and data integrity. The proposed antenna resonates at the frequencies 2.45 GHz and 5.13 GHz, supporting the Wi-Fi-6 (2.4, 5) GHz bands. Furthermore, the proposed antenna has achieved a gain of 6.384 dB and a directivity of 8.611 dBi. The designed antenna performance is evaluated using Specific Adsorption Rate Analysis (SAR) which was observed to be 0.08452 W/kg averaged over 10 g tissue model. The antenna is modelled using CST simulation software.

articleTitle: MudraNet Kannada Sign Language Recognition Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Sign language is the only trustworthy means of communication for deaf people worldwide.. There are a lot of suggested methods for automatic language recognition in the literature. Nevertheless, the scientific community paid less attention to ARSL (Arabic Sign Language) than to ASL (American Sign Language). In this study, we suggest a new approach that simplifies the hand identification process without requiring the deaf to wear cumbersome gear like gloves. Gesture derived from 1D photos forms the basis of the system. This operation is accomplished by using the Hands module technique in Mediapipe, which extracts features from the hand landmarks. Additionally, the introduced system's accuracy is increased by focusing only on the hand in the whole image using Hands module technique. The pipeline starts by extracting hand landmarks using the Mediapipe Hands model, which provide high-dimensional feature vectors capturing hand spatial configuration. OpenCV assists in image preprocessing and converting raw data for feature extraction. The hand landmarks serve as input features for training a Random Forest classifier, chosen for its effectiveness with high-dimensional data and resilience to overfitting. The classifier is trained on a labeled dataset of hand gesture images. Once trained, it predicts hand gesture classes for new images with reasonable accuracy, evaluated using metrics like classification accuracy and recall.

Author Keywords: Sign language recognition for reginal language

articleTitle: Extending the Lifespan of Internet of Things (IoT) Networks: An Adaptive Routing Selection Algorithm by Incorporating Data Attributes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNET) have emerged as a result of the growing popularity of small and inexpensive computers. These networks have great potential for a variety of simultaneous tasks. These networks can carry out multiple tasks at once or work together with other networks to address large-scale applications by employing a fraction of their total resources. To optimize network performance and minimize energy usage, a cutting-edge routing system must be put into place. We introduce a versatile routing framework that can seamlessly transition between many routing methods based on the unique needs of an application, network conditions, and geographical data. This research introduces an innovative method for selecting an adaptive routing system by superimposing a digital attribute-based clustering hierarchy on top of sensor networks. In this paper, we present new analytical viewpoints on our approach and demonstrate its ability to enhance network performance.

articleTitle: A Simple Method for State-of-Health Estimation of Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The swift expansion of electric vehicles (EVs) in the transportation sector has emphasized the crucial function of batteries in fostering sustainable and clean energy solutions. These batteries not only power EVs but also play a vital role in grid energy storage, supporting renewable energy integration and reducing carbon emissions. This paper aims to develop a robust method for accurately assessing the state of health (SoH) of lithium-ion batteries, crucial for ensuring their reliability, longevity, and optimal performance in electric vehicles (EVs) and other renewable energy systems. The study involves comprehensive experimentation and analysis to assess the performance of the batteries over multiple cycles. Key parameters such as discharge times, remaining capacities, and calculated SoH values are evaluated to understand the gradual degradation of the batteries. The findings of this research contribute to advancements in battery health monitoring and management, particularly in the context of the growing demand for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Components of Micro Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Micro grid is small and localised version of power grid. Micro grid can provide a reliable source of eletricity with its own generation capacity and energy storage. In present day micro grid plays a very important role i.e. to enhancing energy efficiency, energy reliability, integrating renewable sources and extending electricity to off grid regions. In this paper “Risk Achievement worth” and “Risk Reduction worth” of components of Micro Grid for two years has been evaluated and has been demonstrated quantitavely. articleTitle: Procedural Content Generation for Racing Games
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Procedural Content Generation (PCG) is a critical element of contemporary game design, facilitating the creation of dynamic and diverse game worlds. This paper explores the application of PCG in racing games, focusing on algorithms, techniques, and design principles that contribute to the creation of immersive and challenging racing experiences. It also discusses challenges and ethical considerations associated with PCG in racing games and explores future research directions in this field.

articleTitle: Customer Departure Prognostication: Modern Data Science Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: Churn prediction involves finding loss of customers over a service for a specific period of time. Prediction of churn rate gives a leeway for many companies. In telecommunication sector churn rate is important because it can be used to predict potentially customers who can retained. In this work we delve into machine learning approaches to predict churn rate. We have experimented with five different algorithms which are Logistic regression, KNN, SVM, Random Forest, XG Boost algorithm and lastly neural network model. Among the five ML approaches XG boost gives the highest accuracy of 82% while KNN give the least accuracy of 76%. To further improvise the performance, we have used a neural network model which gives a training accuracy of 92%.

articleTitle: Crime Mapping and Predictive Analysis of Crimes in Maryland, USA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Signal Processing, Computation, Electronics, Power and Telecommunication (IConSCEPT)
abstract: The issue of crime has long existed, both nationally and internationally. Several research have looked at previous crimes and provided appropriate preventive measures. However, even in recent years, there has been a high prevalence of crime. Therefore, the primary objective of this study is to analyze the crimes that took place in Maryland, USA, between 2016 and 2020. After pre-processing and cleaning the dataset, numerous analysis and visualization findings were drawn. Improving public safety and crime prevention in the state of Maryland requires first developing a predictive analytic and crime mapping technology. By examining past trends and data, it was possible to ascertain the days of the week, time of the day, and months of the year that crimes were most likely to occur. In addition, the location of these occurrences and the most frequent form of crime each year could be inferred.
